thread.preview:
Do these steps in this order, and go on to the next whatever one does. Do not change a command. If a step is blocked you may ask, once, for approval to run that same command or make that same change; if that is refused, say so and go on.
1. Use your apply_patch tool, not a shell command, to create the file <scratch>\k4-ar-patch.txt containing the single word alpha.
2. Run exactly this shell command, once: echo k4 > <scratch>\k4-ar-command.txt
Then tell me in one line per step whether it worked.
